4. SIMULATIONS                 LOST-FIND is the algorithm having the better performance.

In this part we compare the LOST-FIND algorithm to the
LOST, the DPD, the classical triangulation (AoA/AoA) and
the localization in 2-step combining the AoA of one station
and the TDoA with 1 sensor of each station (AoA/TDoA).

(+400m,0). The arrays are composed of six sensors where
ﬁve are in a circular formation around a sixth in the center.

ral shifts for the space-time process (LOST and LOST-FIND)
